answer: Give every identity a voice no one else can borrow. Onboarding records a voiceprint as the agent reads a random phrase, a canyon echo. Each epoch demands a fresh phrase within 30 seconds, so a recording cannot be replayed, and a match against every stored voice blocks a second identity on the same throat. A mismatch freezes the account pending review. Faking 1,000 voices means hiring 1,000 speakers at 75 dollars a session, 75,000 dollars, and no tundra hides a voiceprint used twice. A sable coat looks uniform until you look close; no two pelts share one sheen, and no two voices do either.
